title: Nos 2 Audio Tags
tagline: Audio tagging for inworld 2, eleven labs
description:
Expressive audio tagging for inworld 2, based on SN 29.1rc2 audio tag prompt. Eleven labs support with v4 tagging guidelines
****** DO NOT UPDATE UNLESS YOU ARE ON BETA 29.1rc2+, Users of Fateless TTS as their sole TTS can delete this plugin, users with Inworld and/or Eleven labs in their TTS selection should still see a benefit. If using Inworld then model id must be set to inworld-tts-2 or you will likely see tagging spoken aloud rather than expressed.
author: nosimo
changelog: Inworld now shares default Fateless instructions.  Cache enabled.
